name: CCXP Tour Nordeste
blurb: A one-off 2023 regional spinoff of CCXP held in Olinda, Pernambuco — the brand's first edition outside São Paulo; no further edition has followed.
notes: This was CCXP's first (and so far only) edition outside São Paulo, held Apr 13-16, 2023 at the Centro de Convenções de Pernambuco in Olinda, PE (per contemporary Brazilian press: Folha PE, Design Culture, and the Olinda city government's own announcement). No Nordeste-specific page exists on ccxp.com.br today — /nordeste, /tour-nordeste and /tour all return 404 — and the current ccxp.com.br homepage covers only CCXP26 in São Paulo (Dec 3-6, 2026) with no mention of a Nordeste edition, so this regional tour is treated as inactive/discontinued rather than merely between editions. No official announcement of a future Nordeste edition was found. Cover is null since no current official page or image exists for this one-off event (status is inactive, so a cover is not required).
